subject: Post-demo: hosted trial scope & traffic profile confirmation
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <sam@oliveai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: hosted trial scope & traffic profile confirmation

Hi Samir — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re aligned for a hosted evaluation: 

Recap (what we covered)
- OliveAI wants a lightweight hosted evaluation to validate latency and cost per inference for a summarization flow (~1.5k tokens avg).
- Target environments: staging (EU) and prod (US) eventually; initial pilot can run in US if EU residency not required for the POC.
- Key success metrics: median latency < 220ms for 1.5k tokens, per-token cost target ~ $0.0007, and no dropped requests during 1k rps bursts.

Our proposed quickstart (hosted)
- Endpoints to provision: /v1/generate (streaming), /v1/embeddings (batch).
- Sandbox credentials + pre-provisioned endpoints attached (sandbox-access-instructions.txt).
- Suggested trial rate limits: baseline 20 RPS per endpoint with 200 RPS burst capacity and automatic backpressure. We can increase after we see real traffic.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts — should cut token usage for your doc-summary patterns.

What we need from you
1) Sample traffic profile (attached sample_traffic_template.csv) — hourly % distribution, avg tokens per request, concurrency targets.
2) Confirm whether EU data residency is required for the POC or only for long-term production.
3) Any compliance prerequisites (e.g., procuring a list of IPs for our egress) so we can pre-check network egress rules.

Attachments: redwood_quickstart_onepager.pdf (quickplay), sample_traffic_template.csv, sandbox-access-instructions.txt

Proposed next steps
- You upload the traffic template and answer residency question by EOD Wed (10/14).
- Redwood will provision a sandbox in US region within 24 hours of receiving the template and share credentials.
- 30-min follow-up on Thu to review metrics and adjust rate caps.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ben (solutions) and Neha (security) on technical/controls questions.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Samir Patel <sam@oliveai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted trial scope & traffic profile confirmation

Thanks Michael — great session. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Traffic profile: we anticipate ~5k daily calls during the POC (~peak concurrency 60-80 RPS across all endpoints). I'll try to complete the sample_traffic_template.csv today but wanted to flag the numbers up front.
- Residency: for the initial POC, we can keep staging in US. Production will require EU residency.
- Network: we run in GCP and can add egress IPs. We also require that logs containing PII are redacted before they leave our VPC — is there an option to enable request-level redaction or can we route through a private collector?

Question: does the hosted trial support a private VPC peering option for the sandbox? If not for the POC, we might still need some assurance around log handling and retention.

I can do Thu 10/15 10:00–11:00 PT for the follow-up review.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Product Manager, OliveAI
sam@oliveai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <sam@oliveai.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: hosted trial scope & traffic profile confirmation

Hi Samir — Ben here (solutions engineering). Quick answers and a slightly adjusted proposal so you can evaluate without waiting on a VPC setup: 

1) Residency & sandbox: we can provision the POC in the US immediately; EU-hosted sandboxes are available but take ~48–72 hours to provision and require a billing region change. For your stated timeline, start in US and we can reprovision to EU when you’re ready for production testing.

2) Rate caps & concurrency: given your 60–80 RPS peak estimate, we suggest starting the trial with a soft cap of 100 RPS aggregated (50 RPS /v1/generate, 50 RPS /v1/embeddings) with a 300 RPS burst window for short spikes. We’ll monitor token-level latency and adjust.

3) Log redaction / PII: hosted does not perform tenant-side PII redaction automatically. Options:
   - Route request logging to your collector via private ingestion hook (recommended) so you can apply your redaction pipeline before logs leave your systems.
   - We can set token retention to 0 and enable request-level metadata only, but you’ll lose per-token traceability for debugging.

4) VPC/peering for POC: hosted sandbox cannot be VPC-peered in the initial quickstart. If VPC is a hard requirement, we should evaluate Dedicated or Private options; we can turn up a VPC-enabled sandbox for an extended pilot on a separate procurement path.

Next steps (concrete)
- Michael: once Samir uploads the completed traffic CSV we'll provision sandbox credentials (US) within 24 hours.
- Samir: confirm Thu 10/15 10:00 PT for the follow-up.
- Neha: can you share the minimum audit/log retention configuration we can offer for the trial so Samir can confirm? (I’ve cc’d you.)

I’m attaching a one-page sandbox runbook and the sample traffic CSV again.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
